entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-20
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Regularly encountering fake errors after branch switching; only a restart resolves the issue #78659
  • Avoid `virtual` implementations for `AddSynthesizedAttributes` #78655
  • MSBuildHost should have a `--debug` option #78654
  • `"dotnet.projects.binaryLogPath"` should allow specifying a workspace-relative path #78653
  • Feature request: Add debugger support to compiler-generated class behind IReadOnly collection expression #78651

Closed

  • Explicit tests covering `scoped in T` extension methods should be added. #78491
  • MSBuildWorkspace methods can't be called in the same method body as MSBuildLocator.RegisterInstance #78478
  • `CS0809` "Obsolete member overrides non-obsolete member" not always raised #78548
  • Suggestion: Allow auto-generated Enum.IsDefined parameter checks, similar to the current "Add null check" for reference types #66327
    Backlog
  • Extensions: public API design #78567
    Next
  • Quick fix "Replace auto-property with methods" throws when referenced in source generated file #76672

Created

  • Add CommandLineResource API #78662
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Update MicrosoftVisualStudioExtensibilityTestingVersion #78661
    Area-Infrastructure
  • PROTOTYPE: ManifestResource updates #78657
    Area-Compilers
  • Compare symbols by metadata name when searching for eqivalent symbols in FAR engine #78656
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode

Merged

  • Add untriaged label to all new issues #78658
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Extensions: disallow indexers #78626
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • StaticLogMessage isn't pooling correctly #78652
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #78624
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Fixing symbol publishing #78650
    Next
  • Add `Enum.IsDefined` refactoring #78597
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Extensions: rename syntax node #78625
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Extensions: nullability analysis for property access #78646
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Update Workspace.MSBuild to reference Microsoft.Build.Framework. #78647
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • (WIP) Invoke `dotnet run-api` to obtain virtual project #78648
    Area-IDE, VSCode
